completeOriginalSourceQuestionUnchanged.individualQuestion: Preserve current Resonance Furnace converting ELEMENTAL DAMAGE TAKEN TO RP RECOVERY SUBJECT TO ITS LISTED LIMIT. There is no exact-name Core entry: the preserved Mana Furnace historical candidate says MAXIMUM PB RP PER ROUND,Action/120ft/Instantaneous. Resolve the alias and actual limit explicitly before adopting it; do not silently discard the PB cap. Define recipient,duration,eligible elements,post-mitigation actual HP/tempHP loss,conversion rate,round ledger and sharing/redirection. Resolve self/allied damage and recurring environmental damage without refunds for prevented damage,copying one event or exceeding the RP maximum. Damage remains real and cannot be healed retroactively by calling recovery a conversion.

sourceRecord.completeHistoricalCommonQuestionUnchange: For every selected spell, settle all operational fields: actual activation and components, legal target/range/geometry, duration and concentration, resolution/DC/save or attack, full effect clauses, scaling, repeat casting/source identity, suppression/ending, limits and class-specific rank/cost access. Preserve printed clauses and every original source. Explicitly label NEW completions; no external-game import or automatic historical alias merge.
sourceRecord.completeHistoricalScopeExceptionUnchange: Post-push receipts are preserved only, excluded from current mechanical authoring. Existing faction/alignment/location records do not authorize new cosmology, theology or lore.

completeProposedProcedure.KEEP: Current Resonance Furnace elemental damage taken→RP subject to listed limit. NEW explicit local alias adoption of preserved Mana Furnace Core index187: Action120ft/V,S,F/base21 and MAX PB RP PER ROUND. Both names remain evidence; no second identity or global alias registry changes.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_application: One willing actual living creature with real RP pool, including self; concentration up to60elapsed seconds. Recipient actual PB, not source owner PB, controls the cap. Core Instantaneous becomes this explicit NEW duration. No mitigation/healing/immunity supplied.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_funding: NEW eligible types acid,cold,fire,lightning,poison,thunder for THIS Furnace only. For each genuine damage root/recipient event, after actual immunity/resistance/prevention and legal transfer, count actual lost tempHP + actual lost finite form-bufferHP + actual normalHP lost, typed proportionally by the source-defined allocation (otherwise fixed source component order); exclude prevented points, overkill and direct HP payments. A source transferring damage without new-resource/prevention triggers retains that prohibition. Real self/allied/environmental/recurring damage can qualify, never a fictional hit or duplicate root callback. Count once by root/recipient/damage-event ID; Null nonlethal preserves actual losses but supplies no new funding permission or lethal replacement trigger.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_ratio_clock: Entitlement=floor(eligible actual loss /5)RP per event; no fractional carry. NEW fixed six-second epochs floor(worldElapsedSeconds/6), initialized on the shared encounter clock and retained outside initiative. For each recipient, all Furnaces/casters/copies share one epoch ledger. Its PB cap is captured from that recipient at first eligible event of the epoch; extra turns/recasts/suppression/IDs never reset it. Claim min(event entitlement,cap minus alreadyClaimed). Claimed allowance is spent even if pool full or RP gain subsequently blocked. Next epoch alone resets claim, not prior event IDs. There is no backfill.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_order: Resolve the whole actual damage/life/transform/Wound and required concentration sequence first. Then check surviving same recipient and an operative Furnace. A dead recipient or ended/suppressed Furnace earns0, with no pending reward. In a self-Furnace, damage concentration failure removes it before award; target reaching0 ordinarily incapacitates a concentrating owner. A surviving other-owner Furnace may award to a living Dying/Stable target if a real pool and no other denial permit it; recovery neither heals nor restores consciousness. Recovery cannot reverse the triggering damage or restore spent defenses. Select strongest current same-name cap eligibility, not stacked awards; recipient epoch ledger persists replacement.
